  "Customer_Event_Note_ID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Customer_Event_ID" INTEGER [not null]

  "resident_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "property_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date_moved_in" TIMESTAMP [not null]
}

Table "Customer_Events" {
  "Customer_Event_ID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "customer_id" INTEGER
  "date_moved_in" TIMESTAMP
  "property_id" INTEGER
  "resident_id" INTEGER
  "thing_id" INTEGER [not null]
}

  "customer_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "customer_details" TEXT
}

  "organization_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]

  "organization_details" TEXT
}

Table "Properties" {
  "property_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "property_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "property_address" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Residents" {
  "resident_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "property_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_moved_in" TIMESTAMP [pk, not null]
  "date_moved_out" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Residents_Services" {
  "resident_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "service_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_moved_in" TIMESTAMP
  "property_id" INTEGER
  "date_requested" TIMESTAMP
  "date_provided" TIMESTAMP
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Services" {
  "service_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "organization_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "service_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "service_details" TEXT
}

Table "Things" {
  "thing_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "organization_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "Type_of_Thing_Code" TEXT [not null]
  "service_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "service_details" TEXT
}

Table "Timed_Locations_of_Things" {
  "thing_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Date_and_Time" TIMESTAMP [pk, not null]
  "Location_Code" TEXT [pk, not null]
}

Table "Timed_Status_of_Things" {
  "thing_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Date_and_Date" TIMESTAMP [pk, not null]
  "Status_of_Thing_Code" TEXT [pk, not null]
}
